SCENE 1 (0:00-0:15) — CORPORATE GESTURE → GIFT → GIFT → GEOMETRY
SHOT STRUCTURE: 6 shots, 15 seconds, 16:9

GLOBAL STYLE NOTES:
• lighting_philosophy: overhead fluorescent panels, flat top light, no fill, weak shadows
• color_grade: muted neutral, low saturation — grey carpet tiles, blue-grey partitions, beige desk
• setting: open-plan office, cubicle desk with two monitors switched off showing dark blank screens, plain cardboard box on the desk, midday
• ambience: air conditioning drone, keyboard clatter off-frame, no music
• no readable text anywhere in frame: blank white badge with no printing, dark blank monitor screens, unmarked cardboard box, no labels, no signage, no writing on anything
• characters:
  - MANAGER: age early 30s. visual_anchors: light blue button-down tucked in, lanyard with a blank white badge at collar, silver watch on RIGHT wrist, neat side-parted brown hair, clean shaven, permanent closed-lip smile. voice: bright tenor, upbeat corporate cadence, American
  - LEFTY: age late 30s. visual_anchors: dark green crewneck sweater, black-framed glasses, ballpoint pen held in LEFT hand, short curly black hair, light stubble. voice: dry mid-range, flat, American
  - both read as working adults in the same office, within a few years of each other, no generational gap

SEQUENCE LIST:
SHOT 1 (0-3s) ESTABLISH — WS, locked-off
• vfx: none. Speed 100%
• camera_motion: static wide, MANAGER standing camera-left, LEFTY seated camera-right
• action_visual: MANAGER sets the cardboard box on the desk and takes out a pair of scissors. SFX: cardboard thud
• dialog: ONLY MANAGER speaks — LEFTY keeps his mouth closed, no lip movement. MANAGER (bright tenor, upbeat corporate), then says: 'Happy Left-Handers Day. We got you left-handed scissors.'
• exit: LEFTY takes the scissors
(CUT TO)
SHOT 2 (3-5s) — MCU on LEFTY
• vfx: none. Speed 100%
• camera_motion: static, eye level
• action_visual: LEFTY turns the scissors over once in his LEFT hand
• dialog: LEFTY (dry mid-range, flat), then says: 'Thanks.'
• exit: LEFTY sets them down
(CUT TO)
SHOT 3 (5-8.5s) — MS on MANAGER
• vfx: none. Speed 100%
• camera_motion: slow handheld push-in, MS to MCU over 3.5s
• action_visual: MANAGER lifts a plain white ceramic mug from the box and presents it forward with both hands
• dialog: MANAGER (bright tenor, upbeat corporate), then says: 'And a left-handed mug.'
• exit: mug held out into the gap between them
(CUT TO)
SHOT 4 (8.5-11s) — ECU on the mug, no face in frame
• vfx: none. Speed 100%
• camera_motion: static macro, plain white unmarked mug centred, handle pointing camera-left
• action_visual: MANAGER's thumb rotates the mug 180 degrees so the handle points camera-right. SFX: ceramic scuff
• dialog: no face in frame, both voices are off-screen. LEFTY off-screen (dry mid-range, flat), then says: 'That's a mug.' MANAGER off-screen (bright tenor, upbeat corporate), then says: 'The handle's on the correct side now.'
• exit: rotation stops
(CUT TO)
SHOT 5 (11-13s) PUNCHLINE — two-shot, MS
• vfx: none. Speed 100%
• camera_motion: static, both faces in frame, desk covered in identical plain white unmarked objects
• action_visual: LEFTY looks at the mug, then at MANAGER. MANAGER keeps smiling, expression unchanged
• dialog: ONLY LEFTY speaks — MANAGER keeps his mouth closed, no lip movement. LEFTY (dry mid-range, flat), stress on 'circle', then says: 'It's a circle.'
• exit: MANAGER's smile does not change
(CUT TO)
SHOT 6 (13-15s) FINAL HOLD — ECU on the mug, no face in frame
• vfx: none. Speed 100%
• camera_motion: static macro, same framing as Shot 4, plain white unmarked mug sitting among identical white objects on the desk
• action_visual: nobody in frame, nobody speaks. Total stillness for the full 2 seconds, no movement, no camera move. SFX: air conditioning drone only, room tone continues
• exit: the mug sits unmoved in the silence

GENERATE FIRST: Shot 6 (unpeopled final hold), Shot 5 (punchline lip-sync, single speaker)

  - LEFTY : fin de la trentaine. visual_anchors : pull col rond vert foncé, lunettes à monture noire, stylo à bille tenu dans la MAIN GAUCHE, cheveux noirs courts et bouclés, légère barbe de quelques jours. voice : registre médium sec, plat, américain

• exit : LEFTY prend les ciseaux  
(CUT TO)

• camera_motion : statique, à hauteur des yeux

• dialog : LEFTY (registre médium sec, plat), puis dit : 'Thanks.'

• dialog : MANAGER (ténor clair, corporate enjoué), puis dit : 'And a left-handed mug.'

(CUT TO)  
PLAN 4 (8.5-11s) — ECU sur la tasse, aucun visage dans le cadre  
• vfx : aucun. Speed 100%  
• camera_motion : macro statique, tasse blanche unie sans marque centrée, anse orientée vers la caméra gauche  
• action_visual : le pouce de MANAGER fait pivoter la tasse de 180 degrés pour que l’anse pointe vers la caméra droite. SFX : frottement de céramique  
• dialog : aucun visage dans le cadre, les deux voix sont hors champ. LEFTY hors champ (registre médium sec, plat), puis dit : 'That's a mug.' MANAGER hors champ (ténor clair, corporate enjoué), puis dit : 'The handle's on the correct side now.'  
• exit : la rotation s’arrête  
(CUT TO)  
PLAN 5 (11-13s) PUNCHLINE — plan à deux, MS  
• vfx : aucun. Speed 100%  
• camera_motion : statique, les deux visages dans le cadre, bureau couvert d’objets blancs unis identiques et sans marque  
• action_visual : LEFTY regarde la tasse, puis MANAGER. MANAGER continue de sourire, expression inchangée  
• dialog : SEUL LEFTY parle — MANAGER garde la bouche fermée, aucun mouvement des lèvres. LEFTY (registre médium sec, plat), accent sur 'circle', puis dit : 'It's a circle.'  
• exit : le sourire de MANAGER ne change pas  
(CUT TO)  
PLAN 6 (13-15s) HOLD FINAL — ECU sur la tasse, aucun visage dans le cadre  
• vfx : aucun. Speed 100%  
• camera_motion : macro statique, même cadrage que le Plan 4, tasse blanche unie sans marque posée parmi des objets blancs identiques sur le bureau  
• action_visual : personne dans le cadre, personne ne parle. Immobilité totale pendant les 2 secondes complètes, aucun mouvement, aucun déplacement de caméra. SFX : uniquement le bourdonnement de la climatisation, le room tone continue  
• exit : la tasse reste immobile dans le silence

SCENE 1 (0:00-0:15) — CORPORATE GESTURE → GIFT → GIFT → GEOMETRY  
SHOT STRUCTURE: 6 shots, 15 seconds, 16:9

GLOBAL STYLE NOTES:  
• lighting_philosophy: 天井の蛍光灯パネル、フラットなトップライト、フィルライトなし、弱い影  
• color_grade: muted neutral, low saturation — グレーのカーペットタイル、青灰色のパーティション、ベージュのデスク  
• setting: オープンプランのオフィス、電源の切れた2台のモニターが暗い真っ黒な画面を表示しているキュービクルのデスク、デスク上に無地の段ボール箱、正午  
• ambience: 空調の低い唸り、フレーム外のキーボードの打鍵音、音楽なし  
• no readable text anywhere in frame: 印字のない真っ白なバッジ、暗い真っ黒なモニター画面、無地の段ボール箱、ラベルなし、サインなし、何にも文字なし  
• characters:  
  - MANAGER: 30代前半。visual_anchors: 薄い青のボタンダウンをタックイン、襟元に印字のない白いバッジ付きのランヤード、右手首に銀の腕時計、整えられた横分けの茶髪、髭なし、常に口を閉じた笑顔。voice: 明るいテノール、軽快な企業調の話し方、アメリカ英語  
  - LEFTY: 30代後半。visual_anchors: ダークグリーンのクルーネックセーター、黒縁メガネ、左手にボールペン、短い巻き毛の黒髪、薄い無精ひげ。voice: 乾いた中音域、平板、アメリカ英語  
  - どちらも同じオフィスで働く大人として見え、年齢差は数年程度で、世代差はない

SEQUENCE LIST:  
SHOT 1 (0-3s) ESTABLISH — WS, locked-off  
• vfx: なし。Speed 100%  
• camera_motion: 静止したワイド、MANAGERは画面左、LEFTYは画面右に着席  
• action_visual: MANAGERが段ボール箱をデスクに置き、ハサミを1組取り出す。SFX: 段ボールが置かれる鈍い音  
• dialog: 話すのはMANAGERのみ — LEFTYは口を閉じたまま、唇も動かさない。MANAGER（明るいテノール、軽快な企業調）で、次のように言う: 'Happy Left-Handers Day. We got you left-handed scissors.'  
• exit: LEFTYがハサミを受け取る  
(CUT TO)  
SHOT 2 (3-5s) — LEFTYのMCU  
• vfx: なし。Speed 100%  
• camera_motion: 静止、アイレベル  
• action_visual: LEFTYが左手でハサミを一度ひっくり返して見る  
• dialog: LEFTY（乾いた中音域、平板）で、次のように言う: 'Thanks.'  
• exit: LEFTYがそれを置く  
(CUT TO)  
SHOT 3 (5-8.5s) — MANAGERのMS  
• vfx: なし。Speed 100%  
• camera_motion: ゆっくりした手持ちの押し寄り、3.5秒でMSからMCUへ  
• action_visual: MANAGERが箱から無地の白い陶器マグを持ち上げ、両手で前に差し出す  
• dialog: MANAGER（明るいテノール、軽快な企業調）で、次のように言う: 'And a left-handed mug.'  
• exit: マグが2人の間の空間に差し出されたままになる  
(CUT TO)  
SHOT 4 (8.5-11s) — マグのECU、顔はフレーム外  
• vfx: なし。Speed 100%  
• camera_motion: 静止マクロ、無地で印字のない白いマグが中央、取っ手は画面左向き  
• action_visual: MANAGERの親指がマグを180度回転させ、取っ手が画面右を向く。SFX: 陶器が擦れる音  
• dialog: 顔はフレーム外、両者の声はオフスクリーン。LEFTY（乾いた中音域、平板）がオフスクリーンで、次のように言う: 'That's a mug.' MANAGER（明るいテノール、軽快な企業調）がオフスクリーンで、次のように言う: 'The handle's on the correct side now.'  
• exit: 回転が止まる  
(CUT TO)  
SHOT 5 (11-13s) PUNCHLINE — 2ショット、MS  
• vfx: なし。Speed 100%
